description: Source: Federal Reserve FOMC calendar page and BLS release iCalendar (keyless). Upcoming US FOMC decisions, CPI and Employment Situation (nonfarm payrolls) releases in [now, now+days). Schedules only, no consensus or actual values. Rows carry sourceUrl, fetchedAt and status (scheduled, tentative); coverage says whether the published schedule spans the window. Partial coverage or an outage is ok:false with the reason. Read-only.

limit.description: max rows (default 50); total and truncated report the rest

name: macro_calendar
